question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing left winger, Claire is playing benchwarmer, Dave is playing left midfielder, Eve is playing left back, Fred is playing center midfielder, and Gertrude is playing goalkeeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Bob and Alice trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Claire trade positions. Then, Bob and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) left winger
(C) benchwarmer
(D) left midfielder
(E) left back
(F) center midfielder
(G) goalkeeper
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: striker, left winger, benchwarmer, left midfielder, left back, center midfielder, goalkeeper
1. Bob–Alice: left winger, striker, benchwarmer, left midfielder, left back, center midfielder, goalkeeper
2. Dave–Eve: left winger, striker, benchwarmer, left back, left midfielder, center midfielder, goalkeeper
3. Alice–Eve: left midfielder, striker, benchwarmer, left back, left winger, center midfielder, goalkeeper
4. Gertrude–Bob: left midfielder, goalkeeper, benchwarmer, left back, left winger, center midfielder, striker
5. Dave–Claire: left midfielder, goalkeeper, left back, benchwarmer, left winger, center midfielder, striker
6. Bob–Gertrude: left midfielder, striker, left back, benchwarmer, left winger, center midfielder, goalkeeper
7. Dave–Gertrude: left midfielder, striker, left back, goalkeeper, left winger, center midfielder, benchwarmer
Bob is playing striker, option (A).
Final answer: (A)
